note: Story Safehouses (4 total — houses cannot be bought in Story Mode), Garages (8 Purchasable + 4 Story-Unlocked + Ultimate Edition), and 7 Fences + BuckMe Family Savings.

items.name: Jason's House (Key Lento)
items.features: Floorboard cash stash, wardrobe, sleep save, Ultimate Edition Enduro & Kayak spawn
items.notes: Mariana County starter safehouse. Houses cannot be purchased in GTA 6 Story Mode.

items.name: Chapter 2 Motel Base
items.features: Bed save, trunk staging, proximity to Port Gellhorn pawn shops & Moses
items.notes: WARNING: Permanently closes after completing the mission 'Checking Out'. Clear your stash first.

items.name: Vice City Story Safehouse #3
items.features: Central Vice City base, wardrobe, weapon locker, fast access to jewelry & bank targets
items.notes: Unlocks automatically through Chapter 3 story progression.

items.name: Vice City Story Safehouse #4
items.features: High-end endgame safehouse, full gun cabinet, planning board, garage link
items.notes: Final story-unlocked safehouse in Vice City chapters.

items.name: Paradise Garage (Watson Bay)
items.features: Built-in gun cabinet, multi-vehicle storage, rapid getaway staging
items.notes: Bonus Watson Bay garage unlocked immediately for Ultimate Edition owners.

items.name: Vice Beach Strip Garage
items.features: Multi-car storage, quick oceanfront getaway swap
items.notes: One of 8 purchasable garages across Leonida.

items.name: Little Cuba Lockup Garage
items.features: Vehicle storage near Yasmani's jewelry fence
items.notes: Ideal staging garage for Chapter 3 jewelry & bank runs.

items.name: Downtown Vice Parking Bay
items.features: Underground access for losing 4-star VCPD heat
items.notes: Great disguise/trunk swap point for Large Bank Vaults.

items.name: Port Gellhorn Strip-Mall Garage
items.features: Vehicle storage close to Moses's car fence & pawn shops
items.notes: Convenient for storing untracked cars and duffel-bag haulers.

items.name: Port Gellhorn Industrial Bay
items.features: Heavy SUV & armored truck staging
items.notes: Positioned near western highway corridors.

items.name: Ambrosia Freight Yard Garage
items.features: Industrial storage near gang ops & highway armored trucks
items.notes: Purchasable garage in Leonida's industrial heartland.

items.name: Leonida Keys Boatyard Garage
items.features: Coastal vehicle & water-access staging
items.notes: Quick escape access along the Keys causeway.

items.name: Mount Kalaga Trailhead Garage
items.features: Off-road 4x4 & hunting rig storage
items.notes: Northern Leonida staging point for wildlife & getaway cooling.

items.name: Key Lento Safehouse Drive & Shed
items.features: Starter vehicle parking at Jason's House
items.notes: 1 of 4 story-unlocked garages.

items.name: Port Gellhorn Motel Parking Lot
items.features: Chapter 2 story vehicle bay
items.notes: 2 of 4 story-unlocked garages.

items.name: Vice City Chapter 3 Safehouse Garage
items.features: Chapter 3 heist prep vehicle storage
items.notes: 3 of 4 story-unlocked garages.

items.name: Vice City Chapter 4 Endgame Garage
items.features: Multi-slot endgame getaway garage
items.notes: 4 of 4 story-unlocked garages.

items.name: Moses (Untracked Car Fence)
items.features: Buys untracked stolen cars for $1,000–$2,000 each
items.notes: Best reliable early-to-mid-game car cash loop in Port Gellhorn.

items.name: Randy (Valuables & Pawn Fence)
items.features: Buys stolen watches, electronics, and pawn shop duffel loot
items.notes: Key buyer after unlocking Pawn Shops in 'Coffee Break'.

items.name: Donnie's Trailer Fence
items.features: Early Chapter 1 stolen goods & contraband buyer
items.notes: WARNING: Closes permanently after completing the mission 'Swamped'.

items.name: Brian's Lockup (Keypad Code: 7700)
items.features: Buys drugs, jewelry, and marked bills; keypad safe code 7700
items.notes: One of the highest-utility fences in Leonida—accepts dye-stained/marked bills.

items.name: Yasmani's Jewelry Fence
items.features: Top payout buyer for stolen diamonds & luxury boutique loot (low cut)
items.notes: Unlocks after 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' in Chapter 3.

items.name: Ambrosia Industrial Contraband Fence
items.features: Liquidates gang hideout crates & heavy contraband
items.notes: Ideal drop-off after clearing Ambrosia gang hideouts.

items.name: Grassrivers Wetlands Smuggler Fence
items.features: Off-grid airboat dock buyer for illicit cargo & cartel goods
items.notes: Low police presence along the Grassrivers channels.

items.name: BuckMe Family Savings ($5,000 Ch. 1 Goal)
items.features: Protects savings from Chapter 1 -> Chapter 2 pocket cash wipe; $20,000 free-roam pocket cap
items.notes: Deposit your $5,000 Family Savings into BuckMe before triggering 'Tourist Trap' or loose pocket cash is wiped.
